checks.name: exact narrow control and correction
checks.detail: All mutation verbs target the new owned repo containing .gitattributes and two CRLF text files. Two private copies start from identical cacheinfo-prepared bytes under GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0. Default diff must exit 0 and alter bytes; the command-local diff.autoRefreshIndex=false case must exit 0 and preserve every byte through subsequent ls-files/write-tree. Both full maps and trees must match. Deliberate changed fixture content must still return exit 1 without changing index bytes; original fixture HEAD/index and both product indexes remain exact.

checks.name: fresh ownership and bounded native operations
checks.detail: New task-owned output is required; paths reject reparse traversal; Git and Job helper hashes are fixed. Child-only empty global/system config and hook path isolate the disposable qualification without persistent config changes. Every Git call is hidden, quoted, noninteractive and sequential, under the same owned Job; it has a 10-second bound, asynchronous pipes and bounded output checks. No product executable, database, network operation or broad test is invoked.

checks.name: resource and outcome guards
checks.detail: Controller requires 1 GiB free RAM before Git work and during 100 ms sampling, sets BelowNormal and caps sampled aggregate resident memory at 256 MiB. Work stops at 48 seconds, with a 60-second owned Job deadline and 12-second cleanup reserve. Exact inherited member/handle cleanup is retained; assistance, errors, leftovers or deadline/memory violation cannot be accepted as a pass. Root invocation additionally requires fresh at-least-1-GiB admission before starting this helper.

checks.detail: Read the retained 7094-byte cloud result ac9c04b28df2591569da686c459461b23de2120cb5ab92ccdaa094117b4f232d and independently decoded its three raw DIRC-v2 index artifacts. Their checksums validate; the corrected copy is byte-identical to the prepared index. The control differs only in stat fields for added.txt and tracked.txt, with identical paths, modes, blobs, flags and extensions. This corroborates the proposed mechanism and does not substitute for the pending installed-Git Windows result.
